product_overview: MediTriaje 2.0 is a healthcare operations platform for Colombian hospitals that supports patient registration, triage, appointments, clinical care, bed census, pharmacy dispensing, administrative management, and operational monitoring. It helps different roles manage urgent care workflows and hospital resources from a single web app.
core_goals: Register patients and capture informed consent during account creation
Allow patients to log in, book appointments, complete preliminary triage, and review their medical history and prescriptions
Support nursing staff in emergency admission, patient queue management, and in-person triage classification
Enable clinicians to view their schedule and record patient care in a clinical workflow
Help pharmacy staff review active prescriptions and dispense medications with batch tracking
Provide hospital administrators with access to institutional catalogs, operational audit review, and affiliation import tools
Offer operational staff a live dashboard for hospital KPIs, alerts, and QR-based patient tracking
Manage hospital bed census and assign available beds to active patients

features.name: Patient Authentication and Account Access
features.description: Patients can create an account with informed consent, sign in with email and password, and recover access using an OTP-based password reset flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter personal information -> Review informed consent -> Accept consent terms -> Submit registration form -> See account creation confirmation
Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See patient dashboard
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter account email -> Request recovery code -> Enter OTP code -> Set a new password -> Submit password reset -> See access restored confirmation

features.name: Patient Dashboard and Self-Service Care
features.description: Authenticated patients can access their main dashboard to review care-related information and continue to other patient self-service areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/dashboard -> Sign in with valid credentials -> See upcoming care information and patient summary

features.name: Preliminary Patient Triage
features.description: Patients can complete a preliminary orientation triage to receive guidance before care is provided.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/triage -> Review triage guidance -> Provide requested symptom information -> Submit triage responses -> See preliminary triage result

features.name: Patient Appointment Booking
features.description: Patients can schedule medical appointments based on availability.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/booking -> Review available appointment options -> Select a preferred schedule -> Confirm booking details -> Submit booking request -> See appointment confirmation

features.name: Patient History and Medical Encounters
features.description: Patients can consult their personal history of attended care and medical encounters.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/history -> Review past encounters -> Open a specific record -> See details of attended care

features.name: Patient Prescriptions
features.description: Patients can view their active medical prescriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/prescriptions -> Review active prescriptions -> Open a prescription entry -> See medication details and current status

features.name: Nursing Emergency Admission and Queue Management
features.description: Nursing staff can admit urgent patients, including unidentified patients, and monitor the prioritized emergency queue.
user_flows: Navigate to /nursing/dashboard -> Review prioritized emergency queue -> See current waiting patients
Navigate to /nursing/admission -> Enter patient identification details or mark the patient as unidentified -> Submit emergency admission -> See admission created in the queue

features.name: Nursing Triage Assessment
features.description: Nursing staff can record vital signs and assign an in-person triage level from I to V.
user_flows: Navigate to /nursing/assessment/:id -> Review the patient case -> Record vital signs -> Record Glasgow scale value -> Submit triage assessment -> See assigned triage level

features.name: Professional Daily Agenda
features.description: Clinicians can review their daily schedule of appointments and consultations.
user_flows: Navigate to /professional/agenda -> Review the daily agenda -> Open a scheduled consultation -> See appointment details

features.name: Clinical Attention Record and Closure
features.description: Clinicians can document a patient encounter and close the attention workflow as an immutable clinical record.
user_flows: Navigate to /professional/attention/:id -> Review the active patient encounter -> Record clinical findings -> Add diagnoses and care details -> Save the attention record -> Close the encounter -> See the completed record

features.name: Hospital Bed Census and Assignment
features.description: Hospital staff can review bed availability by site and service, then assign an available bed to a patient with an active episode of care.
user_flows: Navigate to /hospital/census -> Select a hospital site -> Filter by service -> Review bed status across the census -> Choose an available bed -> Assign the bed to the active patient -> See the bed status update

features.name: Hospital Operational Dashboard and QR Tracking
features.description: Operational staff can monitor live hospital KPIs, review alerts, acknowledge operational issues with justification, and look up safe patient location using a QR token.
user_flows: Navigate to /operational/dashboard -> Select a hospital site -> Review live KPI indicators -> See occupancy, waiting times, and alert status
Navigate to /operational/dashboard -> Open an active alert -> Enter a justified acknowledgment reason -> Confirm acknowledgment -> See the alert recorded in audit
Navigate to /operational/dashboard -> Enter a manilla or header QR token -> Request tracking lookup -> See the patient's safe location information

features.name: Administrative Catalog Management and Audit Review
features.description: Administrators can move through hospital catalog sections and review the immutable audit trail.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Move between administration tabs -> Review institutions, sites, specialties, professionals, slots, and other catalogs
Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Open the audit section -> Review the immutable audit log

features.name: EPS Affiliation Bulk Import
features.description: Administrators can download the official spreadsheet template, upload an XLSX file for validation, review row results, and apply the batch.
user_flows: Navigate to /affiliations/import -> Select an EPS from the catalog -> Download the official Excel template -> Prepare the spreadsheet file
Navigate to /affiliations/import -> Select an EPS from the catalog -> Upload an XLSX file -> Review valid and invalid rows -> Apply the batch -> See import results

routes.description: Página de inicio y bienvenida institucional
Inicio de sesión con correo y contraseña
Registro de pacientes con consentimiento informado Ley 1581
Panel principal del paciente con citas y atenciones
Agendamiento de citas médicas según disponibilidad
Consulta de atenciones e historia clínica del paciente
Consulta de recetas médicas activas del paciente
Agenda diaria de turnos y consultas del profesional
Registro y cierre inmutable de atención clínica médica
Panel de urgencias y cola de espera para enfermería
Admisión inmediata de urgencias y pacientes indocumentados NN
Valoración de triaje clínico humano niveles I a V
Ventanilla de dispensación de medicamentos y lotes INVIMA
Censo interactivo de salas, camas y traslados
Centro de Mando Operativo, KPIs hospitalarios y alertas
Panel de administración hospitalaria y catálogos
Importación masiva de afiliados EPS mediante Excel XLSX

features.name: Centro de Mando y Analítica Hospitalaria (Dashboard Operativo)
features.description: Monitoreo en tiempo real de ocupación de camas, tiempos de espera según Resolución 5596/2015, reconocimiento auditado de alertas y seguimiento QR intrahospitalario.
user_interactions: Seleccionar sede hospitalaria en selector desplegable
Activar o pausar actualización automática cada 30 segundos
Hacer clic en el botón de actualización manual para refrescar métricas
Visualizar indicadores KPI de ocupación de camas, pacientes en urgencias, alertas de saturación y camas disponibles
Revisar tiempos promedio de espera por nivel de triaje (I a V) y alertas de exceso sobre la norma colombiana
Consultar tabla de alertas operativas activas
Abrir modal de reconocimiento (ACK) de alerta, ingresar motivo justificado y confirmar registro en auditoría
Consultar ubicación segura de paciente mediante token de manilla o cabecera QR

features.name: Panel de Control del Administrador
features.description: Gestión centralizada de instituciones prestadoras, sedes, especialidades médicas, profesionales, slots de turnos, importación EPS y auditoría del sistema.
user_interactions: Navegar entre pestañas de administración (Instituciones, Sedes, Especialidades, Profesionales, Slots, Calendario, Afiliaciones, Censo, Mando, Reportes, Auditoría)
Configurar segundo factor de autenticación (MFA TOTP)
Consultar bitácora inmutable de auditoría

features.name: Censo Hospitalario y Gestión de Camas
features.description: Visualización de disponibilidad de camas hospitalarias por salas y gestión de movimientos asistenciales.
user_interactions: Seleccionar sede y filtrar por servicio hospitalario
Visualizar estado de camas (Libre, Ocupada, Limpieza, Mantenimiento)
Asignar cama disponible a paciente con episodio de atención activo

features.name: Importación Masiva de Afiliados EPS (BDUA)
features.description: Carga y validación en staging de planillas Excel (.xlsx) con afiliados de EPS, previsualización de errores y aplicación definitiva.
user_interactions: Seleccionar EPS del catálogo oficial
Descargar plantilla modelo oficial de Excel
Arrastrar o seleccionar archivo .xlsx para validación
Ver resumen de filas válidas e inválidas
Aplicar lote en modo atómico o resiliente

features.name: Circuito de Urgencias y Triaje de Enfermería
features.description: Admisión de urgencias presenciales, triaje asistencial escala I-V y gestión de cola de atención.
user_interactions: Consultar cola priorizada de pacientes en urgencias
Registrar nueva admisión (con cédula o NN)
Registrar signos vitales y escala Glasgow para cálculo de triaje
